---
title: "Kanth with R"
pagetitle: "Blog — Kanthanawit"
description: "บันทึกต่าง ๆ ของผม กับ R"
page-layout: full
language:
  listing-page-field-categories: "หัวข้อแนะนำ"
listing:
  contents: "*/index.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  template: _post-list.ejs
  categories: numbered
  fields: [date, title, description, categories, image]
  date-format: "D MMM YYYY"
---

```{=html}
<div class="post-filters" role="tablist" aria-label="กรองบทความ">
  <button type="button" class="post-filter active" data-filter="">ทั้งหมด</button>
  <button type="button" class="post-filter" data-filter="r-tip">R tips</button>
  <button type="button" class="post-filter" data-filter="tidytuesday">TidyTuesday</button>
  <button type="button" class="post-filter" data-filter="map">แผนที่</button>
  <button type="button" class="post-filter" data-filter="statistics">สถิติ</button>
</div>
<script>
// Filter by clicking the matching category in Quarto's sidebar, so this works
// whether or not the installed Quarto base64-encodes category names.
(() => {
  const decode = (v) => { try { return decodeURIComponent(atob(v)); } catch (e) { return v; } };
  const sidebarCats = () => [...document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category .category")];
  const sync = () => {
    const active = sidebarCats().find((el) => el.classList.contains("active"));
    const raw = active ? active.dataset.category || "" : "";
    document.querySelectorAll(".post-filter").forEach((p) =>
      p.classList.toggle("active", p.dataset.filter === raw || p.dataset.filter === decode(raw)));
  };
  window.blogFilter = (name) => {
    const el = sidebarCats().find((c) =>
      (c.dataset.category || "") === name || decode(c.dataset.category || "") === name);
    if (el) el.click();
    sync();
  };
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".post-filter").forEach((p) =>
      p.addEventListener("click", () => window.blogFilter(p.dataset.filter)));
    sidebarCats().forEach((el) => el.addEventListener("click", () => setTimeout(sync)));
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => setTimeout(sync));
    // "r (12)" -> "r 12", and list the most-used topics first ("All" stays on top)
    const count = (el) => parseInt(el.querySelector(".quarto-category-count")?.textContent.replace(/\D/g, "") || "0", 10);
    const container = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category");
    if (container) {
      const [all, ...rest] = [...container.children];
      rest.sort((a, b) => count(b) - count(a)).forEach((el) => container.appendChild(el));
      container.querySelectorAll(".quarto-category-count")
        .forEach((c) => { c.textContent = c.textContent.replace(/[()]/g, ""); });
      // Show the top topics only, with a toggle for the rest
      const TOP = 12;
      if (rest.length > TOP) {
        container.classList.add("is-collapsed");
        const more = document.createElement("button");
        more.type = "button";
        more.className = "topics-more";
        more.textContent = `ดูทั้งหมด (${rest.length})`;
        more.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const collapsed = container.classList.toggle("is-collapsed");
          more.textContent = collapsed ? `ดูทั้งหมด (${rest.length})` : "ย่อ";
        });
        container.after(more);
      }
    }
    setTimeout(sync, 50);
  });
})();
</script>
```
